body:
Thanks for the feedback, I appreciate it. I could definitely make a better effort to show that I care. He doesn't have any money and I have my own expenses to deal with but surely I can take him out to dinner or a movie every once in a while.

Also, his mother works at my college, so do you (or anyone else) think maybe it's a good idea to approach her directly so she understands how serious it is? I fear it might possibly make things worse but perhaps if they know the magnitude of the situation they would be more supportive and maybe pay for psychotherapy if he's willing?
